advanced.name: Large Throwing Wheel
advanced.ability: Once per round, during a Form & Decorate action in which you form at least 1 Vase or Censer, reduce that action's total Clay cost by 2, to a minimum of 0.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在一次制坯饰纹行动中，若你至少制成1件瓶或香炉，该行动的泥总费用减少2，最低为0。（只减泥，不减纹饰费；练泥所制坯不在制坯饰纹行动中；定窑额外坯不是瓶或香炉。）
advanced.shortText: Once per round, Form & Decorate with a Vase/Censer: total Clay −2
advanced.shortTextZh: 每轮一次，制坯饰纹行动含瓶／香炉时：泥总费−2

advanced.name: Decorator's Kit
advanced.ability: Once per round, 1 Carved, Impressed or Painted Decoration you apply costs 1 Coin less. It may be the same Decoration the Shifu's discount reduces.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，你施加的1项刻花、印花或画花纹饰少付1铜钱。可与师傅的纹饰减免作用于同一纹饰（刻花即为0铜钱）。可用于经练泥所付的纹饰；不适用于素面，也不适用于定窑的1铜钱额外坯。
advanced.shortText: Once per round: 1 Carved/Impressed/Painted Decoration costs 1 Coin less
advanced.shortTextZh: 每轮一次：1项刻花／印花／画花少付1铜钱

advanced.name: Reworking Table
advanced.ability: Once per round, when you glaze and load a Shaped vessel, you may first change its Shape to any other Shape: return its Vessel card and take the new one. No Clay is paid; its Decoration stays.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，每当你为1件坯施釉入窑时，可先将其器型改为任意其他器型：退回原器型卡，换取新器型卡。不付泥，纹饰不变。
advanced.shortText: Once per round, glazing and loading a vessel: you may first change its Shape, no Clay
advanced.shortTextZh: 每轮一次，坯施釉入窑前：可改器型，不付泥

advanced.name: Prepared Clay
advanced.ability: Once per round, during a Materials Yard action, after gaining resources, you may form 1 vessel: pay its Clay cost +1 and a Decoration cost. This is a Tech effect, not a Form & Decorate action.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在一次泥柴场行动中获得资源后，你可以制1件坯：支付其泥费用+1，并选择1种纹饰支付纹饰费用。这是技艺效果，不算制坯饰纹行动。
advanced.shortText:
Once per round, Materials Yard action after gaining: you may form 1 vessel
Clay cost +1, pay its Decoration
advanced.shortTextZh:
每轮一次，泥柴场行动得料后：可制1件坯
泥费+1，纹饰照付

advanced.name: Senior Apprentice
advanced.ability: Once per round, 1 Apprentice you place at the Materials Yard or Commission Market resolves the Shifu effect there instead of the Apprentice effect.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，你派往泥柴场或瓷牙行的1名学徒，可改为结算该地点的完整师傅效果：在泥柴场含“付1铜钱得1泥1柴”；在瓷牙行含至多2次承接、其中1次可看三取一、每次承接后得1份资源。不适用于州衙。不使用时，该学徒照常结算学徒效果，本轮仍可留待另一名学徒使用。
advanced.shortText: Once per round: 1 Apprentice at the Materials Yard or Commission Market may resolve the Shifu effect
advanced.shortTextZh: 每轮一次：泥柴场或瓷牙行可令1名学徒按师傅结算

advanced.name: Connoisseur's Cabinet
advanced.ability: At game end, each Fine or Masterpiece ceramic in your Exhibition scores +1 VP, up to +5 VP.
advanced.abilityZh: 终局时，你的终局陈列中每件上品或臻品额外+1分，至多+5分。
advanced.shortText: Game end: +1 VP per Fine or Masterpiece in your Exhibition, max +5
advanced.shortTextZh: 终局：陈列中每件上品或臻品+1分，至多+5

advanced.name: Colour Samples
advanced.ability: When acquired: look at the top 3 Main Orders, reserve 1 of them and discard the rest. This is not a Commission Market action and gives no resource. Ongoing: your Order hand limit is 5.
advanced.abilityZh: 习得时：私下查看主委托牌堆顶3张（不足则看余数），须承接其中1张，其余弃置。此为技艺效果，不算瓷牙行行动，不获得资源，只取自牌堆，委托榜不动。持续：你的委托上限为5张（每次收工均适用）。（只要至少能看1张，承接为强制。所看内容仅你可见；弃置之牌面朝下进入弃牌堆。）
advanced.shortText: When acquired: look at the top 3 Main Orders, reserve 1; hand limit 5
advanced.shortTextZh: 习得时：看主委托顶3张，须承接1张；委托上限5

advanced.name: Kiln Tending
advanced.ability: Once per round, after a Glaze & Load action in which you loaded at least 1 ceramic, gain 1 Clay and 1 Wood.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在一次至少装窑1件的施釉装窑行动之后，获得1泥和1柴。（数字版于每轮首次符合条件时自动结算。经御烧优先或其他技艺效果装窑不触发。）
advanced.shortText: Once per round, after a Glaze & Load action that loads: gain 1 Clay and 1 Wood
advanced.shortTextZh: 每轮一次，施釉装窑行动装窑后：得1泥1柴

advanced.name: Kiln Furniture
advanced.ability: Once per round, when you load 1 ceramic into the Shared Kiln, you may place this tile beneath it and choose its zone modifier for this firing: −1, 0 or +1. Return the tile after firing.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，当你将1件器物装入共窑时，可将本牌垫于其下，并为本次烧成选定该器物的温区修正：−1、0或+1。烧成后收回本牌。只用于共窑。
advanced.shortText:
Once per round, loading into the Shared Kiln: you may place this beneath 1 ceramic
Its zone modifier is your choice of −1/0/+1
advanced.shortTextZh:
每轮一次，装共窑时：可垫于1件之下
该件温区修正自选−1／0／+1

advanced.name: Inverted Firing
advanced.ability: Once per round, when you load a Bowl, Plate or Brush Washer into the Shared Kiln, you may place it in an active space that already holds exactly 1 of your ceramics. Both use that space's modifier (or its Kiln Furniture modifier).
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，当你将1件碗、盘或笔洗装入共窑时，可将其放入一个恰有1件你的器物的启用窑位，包括本次行动先装入的那件。两件器物都使用该窑位的温区修正（若该窑位有支烧窑具，则用窑具修正）。只用于共窑。
advanced.shortText: Once per round: a Bowl/Plate/Brush Washer may stack in a space holding exactly 1 of your ceramics
advanced.shortTextZh: 每轮一次：碗／盘／笔洗可叠入己方仅1件的窑位

advanced.name: Setter's Mark
advanced.ability: Once per round, at the start of the Work Phase (in First Player order), place this tile on an empty active Shared Kiln space. Only you may load there this round. Return it when you load there, or at Cleanup.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，派工阶段开始时（按起始玩家顺序），你可以将本牌放在共窑一个空的启用窑位上。本轮只有你能在此装窑。你在此装窑时，或收工时，收回本牌。（本轮中途习得者，从下一次派工阶段开始时起放置。只用于共窑。）
advanced.shortText: Once per round, at the start of the Work Phase: you may mark 1 empty kiln space; only you may load there
advanced.shortTextZh: 每轮一次，派工阶段开始时：可占1空窑位，仅你可装

advanced.name: Canal Barge
advanced.ability: Once per round, before or after one of your worker actions, you may complete 1 held Order, following every rule for completing Orders. This counts as completing an Order for Ru and Guan.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在你的一次工人行动之前或之后，你可以完成1张在手委托，遵守完成委托的全部规则。此举在一切方面视为完成委托：触发汝窑、官窑与贡瓷，开片器亦可充作纹饰。这是技艺效果，不是工人行动。
advanced.shortText: Once per round, before or after a worker action: you may complete 1 held Order
advanced.shortTextZh: 每轮一次，工人行动前或后：可完成1张在手委托

advanced.name: Protective Saggars
advanced.ability: Once per round, after Quality is assigned, spend 1 Wood to improve the Quality of 1 of your Flawed or Standard ceramics from this firing by one level: Flawed → Standard or Standard → Fine. This cannot create a Masterpiece.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，定品后，你可以支付1柴，将你本次烧成中（共窑或御窑）的1件瑕品或良品提升一级：瑕品→良品，或良品→上品。不能由此成为臻品。不能作用于先前各轮烧成的器物。
advanced.shortText:
Once per round, after Quality: you may pay 1 Wood
1 of your ceramics from this firing: Flawed → Standard or Standard → Fine
advanced.shortTextZh:
每轮一次，定品后：可付1柴
己方本窑1件瑕品→良品或良品→上品

advanced.name: Fuel Ledger
advanced.ability: When choosing Bank or Stoke, you may secretly commit 1 additional Wood with your Contribution card. Reveal them together. If you do, your Contribution becomes −2 or +2.
advanced.abilityZh: 选控火时，若你选择压火或添柴，可随控火牌暗附1柴，与控火牌同时亮出。若如此做，你的控火修正改为−2（压火）或+2（添柴），共付2柴。
advanced.shortText: With Bank or Stoke you may secretly add 1 Wood: the Contribution becomes −2/+2
advanced.shortTextZh: 压火／添柴时可暗加1柴，修正改为−2／+2

advanced.name: Test Pieces
advanced.ability: Once per round, after Base Heat is determined and before Heat markers are set, if you have at least 1 ceramic in this firing, pay 1 Wood to privately look at the top Fire card. You may then put it on the bottom of the deck. You may not show it.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，基础火候定后、翻火标前，若你有至少1件器物在本次烧成中（含御窑），可支付1柴，私下查看窑火牌堆顶1张。然后你可以将其置于牌堆底。不得展示该牌，但可以谈论所见。（按起始玩家顺序结算；付柴与置底为公开信息，所见点数仅你可见。）
advanced.shortText:
Once per round, after Base Heat: you may pay 1 Wood to peek at the top Fire card
You may then put it on the bottom
advanced.shortTextZh:
每轮一次，基础火候定后：可付1柴私看顶牌
看后可将其置于牌堆底

advanced.name: Second Firing
advanced.ability: Once per round, after Quality is assigned, choose 1 of your Flawed or Standard ceramics from this firing. Reveal 1 extra Fire card and recalculate that ceramic's Actual Heat and Quality with the same Base Heat, zone modifier, Kiln Furniture modifier and Heat marker and the new Fire modifier. Jun's adjustment from the first calculation does not carry over. The new Quality replaces the old, even if worse. Discard the extra Fire card after resolving it.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，定品后，你可以选择你本次烧成中的1件瑕品或良品，额外翻1张窑火牌，以相同的基础火候、温区修正、窑具修正与火标配合新的窑火修正，重新计算该器物的实际火候与品质。首次计算时的钧窑调整不保留。新品质取代旧品质，即使更差。结算后弃置这张额外窑火牌；它不影响其他器物。（若本轮尚未使用钧窑，可在重算实际火候后、定新品质前使用。）
advanced.shortText:
Once per round, after Quality: you may refire 1 of your Flawed/Standard ceramics from this firing
Reveal 1 extra Fire card; the new Quality stands even if worse
advanced.shortTextZh:
每轮一次，定品后：可令己方本窑1件瑕品／良品复烧
另翻1张窑火牌重算，结果更差也须接受

advanced.name: Kiln Master
advanced.ability: Once per round, in the Heat marker step, place the Kiln Master marker (+1 or −1 face up) on 1 of your ceramics in this firing that carries no Heat marker. It is a Heat marker for all rules.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在火标步骤中，你可以将窑工标（+1或−1面朝上）放在你本次烧成中1件未带火标的器物上。在一切规则中视为火标。一件器物至多带1个火标；若你先收回了自己的火标，窑工标可放上那件器物。
advanced.shortText: Once per round, Heat marker step: you may place the ±1 Kiln Master marker on your ceramic without a marker
advanced.shortTextZh: 每轮一次，火标步骤：窑工标±1可放己方无火标器物

advanced.name: Tribute Ware
advanced.ability: Once per round, when you complete an Order showing at least 1 Crown, gain 1 additional Crown.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，当你完成一张印有至少1个御令的委托时，额外获得1个御令。（此御令推进御府声望，声望满4后计1分；但它不是印刷御令，不触发官窑，也不计入平局判定②。）
advanced.shortText: Once per round, completing an Order with 👑: gain 1 additional Crown
advanced.shortTextZh: 每轮一次，完成带👑委托时：额外得1个御令
